text:
An object is at rest on a horizontal surface.
Which equation is used to calculate the pressure that the object exerts?
mass of the object
A
area of contact
weight of the object
B
area of contact
mass of the object × area of contact
C
weight of the object × area of contact
D

options.label: C
options.text: mass of the object × area of contact

options.label: D
options.text: weight of the object × area of contact
